rules: All projects must be started from scratch during the hackathon window.
Use of open source libraries and public APIs is permitted and encouraged.
Submissions must include a public GitHub repository link and a demo video or working link.
All team members must check in at least once during the event.

sponsorTracks.name: Best AI Agents & Orchestration
sponsorTracks.description: Best project leveraging autonomous multi-agent workflows or LLM APIs.

sponsorTracks.name: Best Developer Productivity Tool
sponsorTracks.description: Tools that dramatically accelerate developer velocity and code quality.

sponsorTracks.name: Grand Champion
sponsorTracks.description: Overall highest scoring project across innovation, depth, and presentation.

faq.question: Can I submit a project I worked on previously?
faq.answer: No, all core code must be created during the hackathon period. Pre-existing assets or boilerplate must be declared.

faq.question: How do I get help from mentors?
faq.answer: Use the AI Mentor Assistant endpoint or request human mentor intervention via the HackHub dashboard.

faq.question: What happens if our team has an odd number of members?
faq.answer: The AI Skill-Based Team Matcher balances teams into groups of 3 or 4 automatically.
